messages:
elaine: Quick bakeoff sync: we need a concise MVP for sampling presets + cost estimator in Console. Customers want an easy safety-first flow.

jorge: Proposal: three presets (low, medium, full) + per-route override. Low never drops error traces. Medium keeps 10% of tails. Full = 100%.

anya: UX asks: inline cost delta for each preset, a tiny before/after trace thumbnail, and an export button for the policy JSON. Keep copy simple.

sam: Engineering notes: preset -> {rollup_window, sample_rate_default, sample_errors}. Rollup_windows we can support: raw, 5s, 60s. 5s is the sweet spot for most customers.

jorge: Launch acceptance checklist: policy persisted, applied to collector, cost estimate within +/-20% on synthetic load, emergency-capture button toggles 100% for a route.

anya: Acceptance tests: run deterministic replay, apply each preset, assert sampled proportions by class (success/tail/error). Generate thumbnails from sampled IDs.

sam: Risks: aggressive presets might hide infrequent regressions. Add a safety switch: full-error-capture enforced by default for any preset. Also telemetry event for policy changes.

ci-bot: CI job scheduled: observability-presets/integration -> staging 2098883000. Ensure feature-flag obs.presets.beta is set.

elaine: Action items: Jorge -> perf and rollout notes by Thu. Sam -> collector feature-flag + policy cache prototype. Anya -> mocks for cost widget and thumbnail by Wed. I'll update roadmap ticket after these arrive. :thumbsup:
